pid_note: Brief mentioned Omar engine pid 66923. honest_gaps_path_A_cannot_test.why_cannot_test: Probe reuses Omar's already-installed /Applications/Anticipy.app binary directly. A real stranger would download the 2.5 GB DMG, mount it via hdiutil, and copy the .app to /Applications. The DMG download URL was HEAD-probed in STRANGER_INSTALL_AUDIT.json (HTTP 200, 2.5 GB) but the full hdiutil mount and copy flow is not exercised here.

install.sh runs 'xattr -d com.apple.quarantine' on the freshly mounted .app. A real stranger downloading from anticipy.ai will hit Gatekeeper unsigned-binary warning unless the install.sh path is followed. Omar's binary was set up by Omar, so it already lacks quarantine. A stranger running the binary by double-clicking the .app (not via install.sh) would see 'Anticipy can't be opened because it is from an unidentified developer'.

honest_gaps_path_A_cannot_test.gap: Chrome surface bootstrap (clone Default profile, spawn Chrome on 9222)
honest_gaps_path_A_cannot_test.why_cannot_test: Omar's Chrome is in use on 9222. Probe must avoid clobbering it. The probe's browser_surface is reported as extension_native_bridge in /api/state, which works without Chrome contact. A real stranger install would either (a) install the Chrome extension from anticipy-extension.zip and run the native messaging bridge, OR (b) bootstrap the legacy chrome-real-clone path which calls Command::new('/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome') from desktop/src-tauri/src/lib.rs:bootstrap_anticipy_chrome. If the stranger uses Brave, Arc, Chromium, or Chrome installed at a non-default path, the legacy path fails silently with chrome-setup-error event (per prior audit fix recommendation, still open).

Probe never opened the popover UI, so no anticipy:// deep link was minted and no /api/auth/exchange called. The exchange route was inspected in prior audit and returns valid JWTs. A real stranger would sign in via Supabase on www.anticipy.ai, the website would mint a single-use token, the .app would receive it via deep link, and engine would exchange it for an access_token. End-to-end this exchange was not exercised here.

Probe never captured mic audio, so no ASR call fired. STRANGER_INSTALL_AUDIT.json step 9 (BROKEN, blocker) is still open: engine/app/audiostack/audio.py:123 hardcodes v2 model string while the DMG ships v3 weights. A real stranger pressing the listen button on first launch would trigger a 2.5 GB HuggingFace Hub download instead of using bundled weights.

honest_gaps_path_A_cannot_test.gap: OpenRouter / model broker handshake against Supabase user
honest_gaps_path_A_cannot_test.why_cannot_test: Probe has no Supabase session and no OPENROUTER_API_KEY in clean env. Draft path correctly fell back to _infra_fallback=true clarify. A real stranger signs in to Supabase, the website's /api/engine/model gate (verified WORKS in prior audit) proxies their LLM calls billed to Anticipy. This proxy was not exercised here.

honest_gaps_path_A_cannot_test.gap: ElevenLabs TTS proper playback (only macOS say fallback)
honest_gaps_path_A_cannot_test.why_cannot_test: Probe has no ELEVENLABS_API_KEY. The tts.py cascade (verified WORKS in prior audit) falls through to /usr/bin/say. Voice quality difference is dramatic. A real stranger may not have an ElevenLabs key and would default to the system say voice.

honest_gaps_path_A_cannot_test.gap: Real microphone capture and screen recording TCC permission dialogs
honest_gaps_path_A_cannot_test.why_cannot_test: Probe is headless curl against engine API. The Tauri popover UI, TCC permission explainers, and the actual macOS Privacy & Security mic/screen/automation dialogs are not exercised. These are the most fragile UX moments for a real stranger. Recent commit fcde9857 added TCC permission explainers in popover welcome but the live click-through was not tested here.

what_a_real_stranger_would_hit_top_3: (1) Gatekeeper warning on the unsigned .app. Without running install.sh which strips the quarantine xattr, double-clicking Anticipy.app produces 'Anticipy can't be opened because it is from an unidentified developer'. Stranger must right-click + Open, or run install.sh. Per project memory project_phase8_unsigned_dmg.md this is accepted for v1.0.0 but it is the very first stranger touchpoint and worth a one-line README note.

(2) Parakeet ASR weights download on first mic press. STRANGER_INSTALL_AUDIT step 9 BROKEN still open: audiostack/audio.py:123 uses v2 string while DMG ships v3 weights, and neither loads from the bundled DMG resources path. First listen triggers ~2.5 GB HF Hub download. On slow Wi-Fi this looks like 'the listen button is broken'.

(3) Chrome surface ambiguity. If stranger uses Brave / Arc / Chromium / Chrome at non-default path, the legacy chrome-real-clone bootstrap silently fails. Today's default surface is extension_native_bridge (extension + native messaging host), which requires (a) python3>=3.10 (Mac default is 3.9, blocks install.sh per STRANGER_INSTALL_AUDIT finding 3), and (b) loading an unpacked Chrome extension which itself surfaces 'Developer mode extensions' Chrome warning every session.
verdict_rationale: The 7 in-scope Path A steps all PASS: engine binds, mints fresh account, handles trivia inject with real answer, handles draft inject with safe clarify (no email sent), coldstart progresses without crash even without Chrome surface, Omar 8731 untouched throughout, probe cleanly removed. Verdict is PARTIAL_PASS rather than PASS because seven honest gaps documented above (DMG mount, Gatekeeper, Chrome bootstrap, Supabase handoff, ASR weights, OpenRouter proxy, TCC dialogs) are EXACTLY the experiences a real stranger has that this single-Mac simulation cannot reproduce. Marking PASS would be the 100M-percent claim warned against in feedback_no_100_million_percent.md. The blocker carried from STRANGER_INSTALL_AUDIT step 9 (ASR weights version mismatch) is still open and is the most likely first-launch breakage for a real stranger.
next_step_to_upgrade_to_full_PASS: Either (a) burn the DMG to a USB stick and run install.sh on a borrowed Mac (real stranger N=1, not feasible solo on Omar's single Mac), or (b) the brief's Path B (create real macOS user via sudo dscl, run install.sh end to end). Path B was not attempted here because the brief said 'prefer Path A; only attempt B if A reveals a critical gap A cannot test'. Path A reveals seven gaps, but they are documentation gaps not engine-binary gaps, so Path B would only re-prove what's already in the audit. Recommend: fix ASR weights blocker (audiostack/audio.py:123 v2 to v3 + bundle-path load), then schedule a Path B run on the next free hour.
